'''Vicii''' was a thug who worked with the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]], a [[spicerunner]] gang active on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]], alongside [[Vibbo]]. When the Spice Runners' leader [[Zorii Bliss]] confronted former member [[Poe Dameron]], an operative of the [[Resistance]] who returned to the planet on a [[Mission to Kijimi|mission]], Vicii and Vibbo accompanied her, but were knocked unconscious by Dameron's associate [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]. Their unconscious bodies were returned to the [[Spice Runners' Den|den]] of the Spice Runners, where they later awoke. Following the Resistance mission, the [[First Order]] became aware of the gang, whose members were forced to escape. Vicii planned to escape aboard the [[starship]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Carib Diss]] as a return for helping him with a [[bounty]] sometime prior. Kijimi was later [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Derriphan]]'' of the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[fleet]], the [[Final Order]].<ref name="TROS Expanded" />
